meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把对话压缩成交接文档,让下一个智能体顺利接手。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在多个智能体之间接力完成任务。
copy.tagline_en: Compress the conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to hand off context between agents in a multi-step task.

howto.what: 把当前对话压缩成一份交接文档，存入电脑的临时文件夹（不是当前工作区）。文档会附建议调用的技能清单，引用已有文件而非重复内容，并隐去密钥等敏感信息。若你给出参数，会按参数侧重下一阶段工作。
howto.when: 当你说要把对话交接给别的 agent、生成交接文档，或让另一个会话继续当前任务时触发。技能不会自动调用，需要你明确提出。

say.text: 把当前对话整理成交接文档，给下一个会话用。
say.note: Claude 会写好文档存到临时文件夹。

say.text: 生成交接文档，并列出建议调用的技能。
say.note: 文档会包含技能建议部分。

say.text: 将交接文档保存到系统临时目录，隐去API密钥。

howto.what_en: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff doc, saved to the OS temp directory (not workspace). Adds a suggested-skills section, references existing files by path, and redacts secrets. With arguments, tailors the doc to the next session's focus.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to hand off the conversation, create a handoff document, or let another session continue the current task. It is not auto-invoked; you must request it explicitly.

say_en.text: Summarize this conversation into a handoff document for the next session.
say_en.note: Claude saves it to the temp folder.

say_en.text: Generate a handoff doc and list suggested skills to invoke.
say_en.note: It includes a skill suggestions section.

say_en.text: Save the handoff doc to the OS temp directory and redact API keys.
